subject: Request: conditional PO exemption for Nimble Systems pilot
messages:
From: Rachel Santos <rachel.santos@nimble.systems>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-25 09:12 PDT
Subject: Onboarding question — PO vs monthly invoice for pilot

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. Nimble is excited to kick off the 3-month pilot for our data-enrichment flow. One operational ask from our finance team: can you onboard us without requiring Purchase Orders for this pilot?

We typically run pilots on a monthly invoice cadence (net 30) rather than issuing a PO for small short-term pilots. If Redwood can accept invoices without a PO for the pilot term that would speed things up on our side. We attached the completed onboarding form and a brief finance contact card.

Attachments: nimble_onboarding_form.pdf (vendor intake), nimble_finance_contact.txt

Happy to provide additional documentation (W9, bank remit) if that helps. Let me know what information you need and what exceptions process looks like on your side.

Best,
Rachel Santos
Head of Partnerships
Nimble Systems

--
Rachel Santos
rachel.santos@nimble.systems
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-25 11:03 PDT
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding question — PO vs monthly invoice for pilot

Hi Priyom / Laura — forwarding a request from a small pilot (Nimble) asking to be onboarded invoice-only (no PO) for a 3-month evaluation. Details attached.

Key facts: expected spend ~ $2.8k / month during pilot, early-stage startup, they already completed vendor intake and provided remittance details. They asked for invoice-only to avoid internal PO cycles.

My initial thought: allow a conditional no-PO lane for short pilots under $5k/month with guardrails (short duration, contract clause for invoice-only, credit card or prepayment fallback). Priyom — can you share a quick amend/draft we could attach back to the customer? Laura — want to flag in case this needs leadership sign-off or a procurement exception entry.

Next steps I propose:
- Priyom to draft amendment outlining guardrails and evidence required
- Require SOC 2 excerpt or security checklist completed before exception approved
- Limit to 90-day pilot and auto-expire the exemption
- Logging ticket in PROC queue (PROC-912) and include finance approver for audit trail

Thoughts?

Thanks,
Markus
Sr. Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: nimble_onboarding_form.pdf (forwarded)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-26 08:34 PDT
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding question — PO vs monthly invoice for pilot

Markus / Laura,

Thanks — drafted a short "PO Exemption Amendment" that we can attach to the sales order. Draft highlights (attached po_exemption_amendment_draft_v1.docx):

- Scope: Single pilot engagement for Nimble Systems; pilot term 90 days starting on invoice date.
- Spend cap: Not to exceed $9,000 total (approx $3k/mo).
- Security pre-condition: Receipt of SOC 2 Type II excerpt or completed security intake checklist.
- Billing: Net-30 monthly invoices; Redwood retains right to require PO or prepayment if terms are violated.
- Auto-expiry: Amendment terminates at pilot end; any renewal must follow standard PO process.
- Audit: Procurement will create a ticket with finance approver and store amendment in contract repo.

I've included sample language for the contract/legal team and a checklist to capture required vendor evidence. If this looks acceptable I can: (1) attach to the HubSpot deal and send to Rachel, (2) open PROC ticket and route to finance for sign-off.

Questions for decision:
- Do we want a hard monthly cap ($/month) or total pilot cap? I suggested total cap to simplify enforcement.
- Who in Finance signs off on exceptions under $10k total? Last time it was Director of Finance or delegated approver (Dev?)

If you approve I'll circulate to Legal for a quick stamp and then send to Nimble.

Attachment: po_exemption_amendment_draft_v1.docx

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-27 14:22 PDT
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding question — PO vs monthly invoice for pilot

All — thanks for the clear draft. I approve piloting the conditional no-PO lane for Nimble with the following firm requirements before we sign anything:

1) Security evidence: SOC 2 excerpt received (attached: soc2_excerpt_nimble.pdf) or completed security intake. No exception without this.
2) Total pilot cap: $9,000 max (as drafted).
3) Amendment language must include audit clause and auto-expiry.
4) Priyom to log a procurement exception ticket in Jira (PROC-912) and tag Dev as finance approver; capture approver name and timestamp in ticket.

Please proceed: Priyom, send the amendment to Legal (cc: Laura) for a quick sign-off and then to Rachel. Mark the ticket and attach the final amendment and vendor intake to the PROC record.

I'll review the ticket later today. This pilot is low risk but we need the paper trail.

Laura Bennett
Director, Business Operations
Redwood Inference
